infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Club Check uses your location during a round to notice when you leave a green and remind you to check for your clubs.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Club Check uses your location during a round, including while your phone is locked in your pocket or golf bag, to notice when you leave a green and remind you to check for your clubs. Location is only used during rounds you start and never leaves your phone.
